ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: at the top of the schematic diagram, from left to right, there are four numbered boxes, respectively labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4; there is a connecting arrow between 1 and 2, and there are rightward transmission arrows from 2 to 3 and from 3 to 4; each numbered box is also connected with the lower long box, and the lower long box is labeled “pond-bottom silt.” Then combine the material for reasoning: corn is planted in spring and cauliflower is planted in autumn; corn stalks and cauliflower leaves are used to raise pigs and sheep, so 1 corresponds to corn and cauliflower, and 2 corresponds to pigs and sheep; after pig manure enters the crab pond, it becomes nutrition for planktonic aquatic organisms, so 3 corresponds to planktonic aquatic organisms; plankton creates an excellent water environment and lays a foundation for the quality of shrimp and crabs, therefore 4 after 3 corresponds to shrimp and crabs.
